test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter cluster.

DISMAY : SIDYAM :: DRIVER : IRDREV :: SAFARI : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• First three letters → Written diagonally
 
• Last three letters → Written diagonally

So,

 
• DISMAY : SIDYAM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51eef208be8d3c2130c2aa6e3eab6b60b0ae75d74fd8d0e8c00f50ffee173def.png] 

And,

 
• DRIVER : IRDREV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a51bb21abc229a2cffc8ec4889e39fb146c8f493df6f13864013366b23a55b40.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• SAFARI : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0907fbbb10d0164ad09876f23e36a7d6b08ee6d2ad2ca346e539ec5931204c0e.png] 

​Hence, "**FASIRA**" is the correct answer.

49
